letter.role_title: Studentische Hilfskraft (HiWi) - Physical AI, Humanoide Robotik und Computer Vision
letter.opening: I would like to apply for the student assistant position in Physical AI, humanoid robotics and computer vision at the Lehrstuhl FAPS. I am enrolled in the MSc Data Science programme here at FAU, and computer vision is the part of my work with the most evidence behind it: object detection, face recognition and Convolutional Neural Network training in Python and PyTorch.
letter.profile_intro: Before moving to Erlangen I completed four applied artificial intelligence and machine learning roles in India. The most recent, an internship at Elevate Labs, ended with recognition as Best Performer of the cohort after 8 end-to-end machine learning projects. My final-year thesis project, PrisonSecure, is a deep-learning surveillance system that runs on live CCTV feeds, and it was published in the ICISD 2025 proceedings by Atlantis Press (Springer Nature).

achievements.lead: Object detection on a live video pipeline
achievements.impact: PrisonSecure reached 95.79% mAP@0.5 with precision and recall both at 0.93 for weapon detection, with hard negative mining to suppress false positives from visually similar objects.
A ResNet-based detector, FaceNet embeddings and an SVM classifier identified individuals at 93.75% accuracy on the same feed, with real-time audio alerting on detection.
For an American Sign Language image-recognition system I implemented the full training, validation and inference pipeline, including data augmentation to improve generalisation.

achievements.lead: Evaluation treated as part of the work
achievements.impact: Across 8 projects at Elevate Labs I picked the metric that fitted the problem, from 95%+ ROC-AUC on a Support Vector Machine tuned by GridSearchCV to 96.1% R² on an XGBoost sales forecast.

letter.problems_section: The posting says the concrete tasks follow the applicant's prior knowledge, so I want to be precise about what mine is. I can take on the perception side of a demonstrator: preparing image data, training detection and recognition models, and measuring them properly before anyone relies on the output. Robotics, humanoid systems and Physical AI are new to me, and I have not worked with ROS or ROS 2. I would treat both as things to learn in the group rather than as experience I already have.
letter.closing: I am enrolled at FAU until August 2028, so a longer-term collaboration fits my schedule. My CV is attached and I can send my current transcript of records immediately. Two questions from my side: what weekly hours do you have in mind, and which HiWi pay band applies given a completed Bachelor's degree in Computer Science?
letter.language_closing: Ich lerne derzeit Deutsch auf dem Niveau A2 und arbeite auf B1 hin.
